```{python}
#| output: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import polars as pl
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from _guard import load, load_json, source

# The document of record is data.html; this page is the instrument. Same
# fail-closed inputs, same fixed identity->colour assignment as the static
# figures -- colour follows the province, never its rank in any one chart.
COLOR = {"Ituri": "#0072B2", "Nord-Kivu": "#D55E00", "Haut-Uélé": "#009E73",
         "Tshopo": "#CC79A7", "Sud-Kivu": "#56B4E9", "Bas-Uélé": "#E69F00"}

LAYOUT = dict(
    template="plotly_white", height=520,
    margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=30, b=40),
    hovermode="closest",
    legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.01, x=0),
)

series = load("data/build/series/province_series.csv")
zt = load("data/build/series/zone_table.csv")
st = load("data/build/series/zone_table_status.csv")
summ = load("data/build/series/province_summary.csv")
cav = load("data/build/series/provisional_caveat.csv")
caveat_reports = set(cav.filter(pl.col("kind") == "recent_data_provisional")["sitrep"])
route = dict(st.select("sitrep", "table").iter_rows())
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Cumulative by province

Hover a point for the report it came from, its route, and both routes' values.
The line is the sum of the printed health-zone rows; open rings are the
printed provincial-summary row, a check — a gap between them is a finding.

```{python}
fig = go.Figure()
for prov, c in COLOR.items():
    d = (series.filter((pl.col("province") == prov)
                       & pl.col("cum_cases").is_not_null()).sort("date"))
    if d.height == 0:
        continue
    hover = [
        f"<b>{prov}</b> — sitrep {r['sitrep']:03d} ({r['date']})<br>"
        f"cases {r['cum_cases']:,} · deaths "
        f"{'—' if r['cum_deaths'] is None else format(r['cum_deaths'], ',')}"
        f"<br>zone rows summed: {r['n_parts']}"
        f"<br>route: {route.get(r['sitrep'], '—')}"
        + ("<br>⚠ source marks recent data provisional"
           if r["sitrep"] in caveat_reports else "")
        for r in d.iter_rows(named=True)]
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=d["date"].to_list(), y=d["cum_cases"].to_list(),
        mode="lines+markers", name=prov, line=dict(color=c, width=2),
        marker=dict(size=5), hovertext=hover, hoverinfo="text"))
    s = (summ.filter((pl.col("level") == "province")
                     & pl.col("cum_cases").is_not_null())
         .with_columns(pl.col("zone_reported").str.strip_chars("*†‡ "))
         .filter(pl.col("zone_reported") == prov))
    if s.height:
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x=s["date"].to_list(), y=s["cum_cases"].to_list(),
            mode="markers", name=f"{prov} (printed summary)",
            marker=dict(symbol="circle-open", size=8, color=c),
            hovertext=[f"<b>{prov}</b> printed summary — sitrep "
                       f"{r['sitrep']:03d}: {r['cum_cases']:,}"
                       for r in s.iter_rows(named=True)],
            hoverinfo="text", showlegend=False))
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", title="cumulative confirmed cases")
fig.update_layout(**LAYOUT)
fig.show()
```

## Daily flows

One point per report, at its reporting date, exactly as published. Zeros are
real: reports whose cumulative did not move. Use the legend to isolate a
province; the pink band along the bottom marks reports whose source cautions
its recent figures are still consolidating.

```{python}
fig = go.Figure()
for prov in ("Ituri", "Nord-Kivu"):
    c = COLOR[prov]
    d = (series.filter((pl.col("province") == prov)
                       & pl.col("cum_cases").is_not_null()).sort("date")
         .with_columns((pl.col("cum_cases") - pl.col("cum_cases").shift(1))
                       .alias("inc")).drop_nulls("inc"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=d["date"].to_list(), y=d["inc"].to_list(),
        mode="markers", name=f"{prov} cases/day",
        marker=dict(size=6, color=c),
        hovertext=[f"<b>{prov}</b> sitrep {r['sitrep']:03d} ({r['date']})<br>"
                   f"+{r['inc']} cases since previous report"
                   for r in d.iter_rows(named=True)],
        hoverinfo="text"))
cavd = cav.filter(pl.col("kind") == "recent_data_provisional")
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=cavd["date"].to_list(), y=[0.4] * cavd.height, mode="markers",
    marker=dict(symbol="line-ns-open", size=10, color="#d4699e"),
    name="source: data still consolidating",
    hovertext=[f"sitrep {s:03d}: source cautions recent data are provisional"
               for s in cavd["sitrep"].to_list()],
    hoverinfo="text"))
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", title="new confirmed cases per report (log)")
fig.update_layout(**LAYOUT)
fig.show()
```

## Weekly fitted streams

The exact series the models consume, from `data/build/streams/` — weekly
binned incidence, revisions kept negative, every stream ending at a zero gap
against the printed totals.

```{python}
meta = load_json("data/build/streams/meta.json")
fig = go.Figure()
slug2prov = {"ituri": "Ituri", "nord_kivu": "Nord-Kivu",
             "haut_uele": "Haut-Uélé"}
for slug, prov in slug2prov.items():
    d = load(f"data/build/streams/cases_{slug}.tsv")
    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
        x=d["time"].to_list(), y=d[f"cases_{slug}"].to_list(),
        name=f"{prov} cases/wk", marker_color=COLOR[prov], opacity=0.85,
        hovertemplate="week ending %{x}<br>%{y} cases<extra>" + prov + "</extra>"))
    dd = load(f"data/build/streams/deaths_{slug}.tsv")
    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
        x=dd["time"].to_list(), y=dd[f"deaths_{slug}"].to_list(),
        name=f"{prov} deaths/wk", marker_color=COLOR[prov], opacity=0.45,
        hovertemplate="week ending %{x}<br>%{y} deaths<extra>" + prov + "</extra>"))
fig.update_layout(barmode="group", **LAYOUT)
fig.update_yaxes(title="weekly count")
fig.show()
```

## Ours vs INRB

Every zone-day both lineages state, on the identity line. Agreement is
evidence about transcription, never about the counts — all lineages read the
same pages. Hover a red point for the full record of the disagreement.

```{python}
dis = load("data/build/compare/inrb_disagreements.csv")
zz = (zt.filter(pl.col("level") == "zone")
      .select("sitrep", "date", "zone_reported", "cum_cases"))
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[1, 5000], y=[1, 5000], mode="lines",
                         line=dict(color="#cccccc", width=1),
                         showlegend=False, hoverinfo="skip"))
agree_x, agree_y = [], []
diskeys = set(zip(dis["sitrep"], dis["date"]))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=dis["inrb_cases"].to_list(), y=dis["cum_cases"].to_list(),
    mode="markers", name=f"disagree ({dis.height})",
    marker=dict(size=10, color="#D55E00"),
    hovertext=[f"<b>{r['zone_reported']}</b> — sitrep {r['sitrep']:03d} "
               f"({r['date']})<br>ours {r['cum_cases']} · INRB "
               f"{r['inrb_cases']} · Δ {r['diff_cases']:+d} cases"
               + (f"<br>deaths Δ {r['diff_deaths']:+d}"
                  if r["diff_deaths"] not in (None, 0) else "")
               for r in dis.iter_rows(named=True)],
    hoverinfo="text"))
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", title="INRB-UMIE transcription")
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", title="this extraction")
fig.update_layout(**LAYOUT)
fig.show()
```

## Report index

```{python}
ex = source("registers/reconciliation_exceptions.tsv")
exset = set(ex["sitrep"].cast(pl.Int64))
from IPython.display import Markdown
rows = []
for r in st.sort("sitrep").iter_rows(named=True):
    flags = []
    if r["sitrep"] in caveat_reports:
        flags.append("caveat")
    if r["sitrep"] in exset:
        flags.append("exception")
    rows.append(f"| {r['sitrep']:03d} | {r['date']} | {r['table'] or '—'} | "
                f"{r['rows']} | {r['identity'] or '—'} | "
                f"{'' if r['residual'] is None else r['residual']} | "
                f"{', '.join(flags)} |")
Markdown("| report | date | route | rows | identity | residual | flags |\n"
         "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n" + "\n".join(rows))
```
